text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober hurt herself during
training, so I go
to see how she's doing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You came all this way just to check on
me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh... You didn't need to do that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to worry about me. Just
think of
this as a longer-than-usual
break.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't really hurt anymore, and if
anything,
you fussing over me makes it
harder to relax...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't really hurt anymore, and if
anything,
you fussing over me makes it
harder to relax...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll head back to training after resting a
bit more.
You can go on ahead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I thought you'd say that.
choice_data_list: まずはしっかり休もう
choice_data_list_en: First, let's get plenty of rest.
Are you pushing yourself too hard...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If I rush back and it gets worse, you'll
just fuss
over me even more and never
leave...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I know you're worried about me, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Fine. I'll rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Fine. I'll rest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober looks a little frustrated,
but she
agrees to rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm not. And it's really not a big deal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
A little bruise like this isn't going to stop
me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ungh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh. I-I don't suppose you'd believe
me if I said
I was fine... Ow...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she shouldn't be moving her
leg yet.
Mejiro Dober is visibly
crestfallen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shortly after I leave the infirmary, Mejiro
Dober
catches up with me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't hurt anymore, so I shouldn't
have a
problem moving around.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Let's get started. I have to make up for
all the
time I lost.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her injury doesn't bother her too much,
so Mejiro
Dober and I restart training
without pushing her
too hard!
